units.characteristics: righteous vs wicked (moral-poles arena)
units.gist: the antithesis frame of ch 10 - the specific inner-being findings sit within it

units.characteristics: the inner condition legible in speech
units.gist: the dominant thread - mouth of the righteous a fountain of life; concealed hatred = lying lips; many words = transgression; restrained lips prudent; tongue of righteous = silver / heart of wicked worthless

units.characteristics: diligence vs sloth
units.gist: the slack vs diligent hand; gathering in summer vs sleeping in harvest; the sluggard as vinegar/smoke

units.characteristics: desire / hope of the righteous vs dread of the wicked
units.gist: God thwarts the craving of the wicked; 'what the wicked dreads comes... the desire of the righteous is granted'; 'the hope of the righteous brings joy'

units.characteristics: receptivity / heeding instruction
units.gist: the wise of heart receive commandments; 'whoever heeds instruction is on the path to life'

units.characteristics: love vs hate as relational drivers
units.gist: GEM - 'hatred stirs up strife, but love covers all offenses'

units.characteristics: fear of the LORD (life-lengthening)
units.gist: 'the fear of the LORD prolongs life' (fear-of-LORD thread)

units.characteristics: righteous/upright vs wicked/treacherous (arena)
units.gist: the antithesis frame of ch 11

units.characteristics: pride vs humility
units.gist: GEM - 'when pride comes, then comes disgrace, but with the humble is wisdom' (pride/humility thread, w/ 15:33/16:18)

units.characteristics: speech - slander, secrets, the destroying/ delivering mouth
units.gist: the godless mouth destroys the neighbour; belittling vs restrained silence; slander reveals secrets vs the trustworthy spirit that keeps covered

units.characteristics: generosity vs withholding; kindness benefits the self
units.gist: 'a man who is kind benefits himself, a cruel man hurts himself'; 'one gives freely yet grows richer; another withholds and suffers want'; whoever waters is watered

units.characteristics: mis-placed trust in riches
units.gist: 'whoever trusts in his riches will fall, but the righteous flourish like a green leaf' (mis-placed trust, w/ Ps 49/52/62)

units.characteristics: the desire of the righteous ends in good
units.gist: 'the desire of the righteous ends only in good, the expectation of the wicked in wrath'

units.characteristics: righteous vs wicked (arena)
units.gist: the antithesis frame of ch 12

units.characteristics: teachability - loving discipline vs hating reproof
units.gist: GEM - 'whoever loves discipline loves knowledge, but he who hates reproof is stupid'; also 12:15 'the way of a fool is right in his own eyes, but a wise man listens to advice'

units.characteristics: speech - rash words vs healing tongue; truth vs lies
units.gist: rash words like sword thrusts vs the tongue of the wise that heals; truthful lips endure, a lying tongue is momentary; from the fruit of the mouth a man is satisfied

units.characteristics: the heart's thoughts / plans
units.gist: 'the thoughts of the righteous are just; deceit is in the heart of those who devise evil, but those who plan peace have joy'

units.characteristics: anxiety weighing the heart; the gladdening word
units.gist: GEM - 'anxiety in a man's heart weighs him down, but a good word makes him glad' (the felt-interior thread)

units.characteristics: diligence vs sloth
units.gist: the diligent hand will rule; the slothful put to forced labour; the diligent get precious wealth

units.characteristics: righteous/wise vs wicked/fool (arena)
units.gist: the antithesis frame of ch 13

units.characteristics: desire, craving, hope deferred/fulfilled
units.gist: the felt-interior gems - 'the soul of the sluggard craves and gets nothing'; 'HOPE DEFERRED makes the heart sick, but a desire fulfilled is a tree of life'; 'a desire fulfilled is sweet to the soul'; the righteous satisfies his appetite

units.characteristics: guarding the mouth preserves the self
units.gist: 'whoever guards his mouth preserves his life; he who opens wide his lips comes to ruin'

units.characteristics: receptivity - hearing instruction, revering the word
units.gist: a wise son hears; by insolence comes strife but with those who take advice is wisdom; despising the word brings destruction, revering it rewarded; heeding reproof honoured

units.characteristics: formation by company
units.gist: GEM - 'whoever walks with the wise becomes wise, but the companion of fools will suffer harm' (the self shaped by its company, w/ Ps 1:1)

units.characteristics: wise/upright vs fool/wicked (arena)
units.gist: the antithesis frame of ch 14

units.characteristics: the heart's private, unshared interior
units.gist: CORNERSTONE of the felt-interior - 'the heart knows its own bitterness, and no stranger shares its joy'; 'even in laughter the heart may ache, and the end of joy may be grief' - the incommunicable inner life

units.characteristics: anger / temper vs the tranquil heart
units.gist: 'a man of quick temper acts foolishly'; 'whoever is slow to anger has great understanding, a hasty temper exalts folly'; 'A TRANQUIL HEART gives life to the flesh, but envy makes the bones rot'

units.characteristics: fear of the LORD - confidence, refuge, fountain of life
units.gist: 'in the fear of the LORD one has strong confidence, and his children will have a refuge'; 'the fear of the LORD is a fountain of life'

units.characteristics: credulity vs considered steps
units.gist: 'the simple believes everything, but the prudent gives thought to his steps' (discernment)

units.characteristics: self-deception - the way that seems right
units.gist: GEM - 'there is a way that seems right to a man, but its end is the way to death' (the self misreading its own path, cf. 16:25)

units.characteristics: regard for the poor as regard for the Maker
units.gist: 'whoever oppresses a poor man insults his Maker, but he who is generous to the needy honours him'

units.characteristics: righteous/wise vs wicked/fool (arena)
units.gist: the antithesis frame of ch 15

units.characteristics: the soft answer; slow-to-anger quiets strife
units.gist: GEM - 'a soft answer turns away wrath, but a harsh word stirs up anger'; 'a hot-tempered man stirs up strife, but he who is slow to anger quiets contention'

units.characteristics: the felt heart - glad/crushed/cheerful/afflicted
units.gist: the felt-interior thread - 'a glad heart makes a cheerful face, but by sorrow of heart the spirit is crushed'; 'the cheerful of heart has a continual feast'; 'the light of the eyes rejoices the heart, good news refreshes the bones'

units.characteristics: God sees the heart
units.gist: 'the eyes of the LORD are in every place, keeping watch on evil and good'; 'Sheol and Abaddon lie open before the LORD; how much more the hearts of the children of man!' (w/ Ps 139)

units.characteristics: the ear that hears reproof; the seeking heart
units.gist: 'the heart of him who has understanding seeks knowledge'; 'the ear that listens to life-giving reproof will dwell among the wise'; 'whoever ignores instruction despises himself'

units.characteristics: contentment - the little with fear/love better than much with trouble
units.gist: GEM - 'better is a little with the fear of the LORD than great treasure and trouble'; 'better a dinner of herbs where love is than a fattened ox and hatred'

units.characteristics: the heart that ponders before answering
units.gist: 'the heart of the righteous ponders how to answer, but the mouth of the wicked pours out evil' (the considered vs impulsive interior)

units.characteristics: fear of the LORD + humility before honour
units.gist: 'the fear of the LORD is instruction in wisdom, and humility comes before honour' (fear + humility, closes the chapter)
